sloka: अदन् बुभुक्षितो मांसं शोणितं तृषितः पिबन् ।मेदःकुम्भांश्च मद्यं च पपौ शक्ररिपुस्तदा ।। ६.६०.६४ ।।।।
transliteration: adan bubhukṣito māṁsaṁ śoṇitaṁ tṛṣitaḥ piban ।medaḥkumbhāṁśca madyaṁ ca papau śakraripustadā ।। 6.60.64 ।।।।

translations.english: With sleepy eyes casting his glance at the night rangers looked at all of them.
